nodes.label: OpenVINO SSDLite Model Converter
nodes.rationale: Replaces the legacy openvino-dev Model Optimizer with a hand-built conversion. The TensorFlow frontend translates the Object Detection API pre and post processors literally, producing per-class NonMaxSuppression, NonZero and Loop ops with data dependent shapes that the GPU plugin handles very badly. The preprocessor is bypassed as an identity at the native 300x300 input and the postprocessor is replaced by a single fused DetectionOutput, reproducing what ssd_v2_support.json used to do. Anchors are folded to a constant since they depend only on the static input shape. Build-time asserts fail the image rather than silently shipping a dynamically shaped graph.

edges.source_location: the converted IR targets the Intel GPU plugin whose OpenCL/level-zero runtime install_deps.sh provides
both exist solely to work around inadequate upstream Intel GPU support: one rebuilds the media driver for Xe2, the other rewrites the model graph because the GPU plugin handles dynamic shapes badly
